clock_state.rule: DRIFT excludes; BOTH LEVEL sides are kept with the side recorded, because the under-load clock is set per tile by the kernel's own power draw under the cap; the fixed roof is what the compute-bound gates score against; the four LEVEL counts are over the STEADY cells only and the five counts partition the timed cells; this arm drops no cell for its clock

gates.claim: the forced tile is the tile that ran
gates.measured: 128 of 128 cells showed their requested tile; 8 of 8 settings compiled at least one fresh Triton artefact
gates.threshold: every ok cell shows its requested tile, and every setting compiled
gates.invalidates: EVERY M GATE. A run in which the override never reached the kernel is one kernel measured at every setting, so M1's 'the anchor does not depend on the swizzle' passes by construction and the report reads as a tidy null result. That world was executed against this file's scorer on 2026-09-02: M0-M5 all returned PASS.
every count below. A cell that failed silently is a bracket built on a different grid from the one the plan printed

gates.claim: the committed ceiling is above the measured read rate on the real weight buffers
gates.invalidates: the bracket's upper end. A ceiling below the data is not a ceiling, and every alpha_hi computed from it is too low

gates.claim: P4: the anchor rate never exceeds the measured ceiling
gates.invalidates: the bracket outright on this card: an anchor above the ceiling inverts the interval
